title: Zentramesh: Network & ISP Infrastructure Engine
description: Core networking engine powering Netra.ng and Superkonnect. Interfaces with cloud-hosted TP-Link Omada SDN controllers (ER605 routers & EAP 650 APs) to automate user authentication, billing, and bandwidth shaping—serving hundreds of active users and managing millions of NGN in revenue.

title: Superkonnect: Network Access & Billing Platform
description: Powered by Zentramesh, Superkonnect provides seamless captive portal authentication, dynamic voucher generation, and real-time subscription management for high-density internet access networks.

title: Tonzscrow: Decentralized Escrow API
description: A robust Web3 backend microservice built with Go and PostgreSQL that facilitates trustless escrow transactions. Integrates directly with TON smart contracts to hold and release funds based on multi-sig approval workflows.

title: AI-Powered RAG Microservice
description: An asynchronous Node.js microservice utilizing RabbitMQ and OpenAI API. Ingests thousands of PDF documents, generates vector embeddings, stores them in vector databases, and serves context-aware RAG queries with sub-second response times.

title: High-Frequency Trading Websocket Engine
description: A low-latency real-time market data streaming pipeline built in Rust and Next.js, capable of serving 10,000+ concurrent WebSocket connections with sub-50ms latency.

title: Tonzilla: Encrypted Telegram Mini App
description: A Telegram mini app for private file sharing, allowing users to securely upload, encrypt, and share files directly within Telegram using TON decentralized storage.

title: Morm: Golang MongoDB ODM
description: A lightweight Object Document Mapper (ODM) for Golang, inspired by Mongoose. Built on top of the official MongoDB Go driver and reflection API for developer-friendly database interactions.

title: Sociallio: Marketing Automation Engine
description: An automated social media management system featuring scheduled publishing, analytics tracking, and multi-account queue orchestration using Redis and BullMQ.

title: Dehub.io: Web3 Streaming Platform
description: A decentralized video streaming platform leveraging IPFS and Livepeer for censorship-resistant media distribution and direct tokenized creator monetization.

title: Allwebtool: AI Directory Aggregator
description: A centralized directory and aggregator for top AI tools, offering a unified portal for discovering, comparing, and testing AI models.
